image_description: A white minibus with a red stripe along the lower body and red wheel rims, parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape typical of older van-based minibuses, with a sliding side door, large windshield, and visible front grille and headlights. There are stickers on the windshield and some text/logos on the front panel. The background includes trees and a partial view of a building.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a compact, boxy silhouette distinct from full-size buses, with sufficient roof height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is prominent, and multiple side windows are visible along the passenger cabin section.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width, and a sliding entrance door is clearly visible on the near side (mid-body).
A sliding door track and handle mechanism are visible on the side of the vehicle, consistent with a sliding entrance door.
The short hood and front grille structure indicate a front-engine layout typical of this class of van/minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in the image; only the front three-quarters are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a red stripe and red wheels, which constitutes a specific livery scheme.

The window configuration and overall dimensions are consistent with a capacity of 4-10 passengers.

artifact_observations.location: Front grille/logo area and windshield stickers
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the front panel below the windshield and the blue stickers on the glass appear distorted and illegible, characteristic of AI-generated text artifacts. The logo shapes are suggestive but lack coherent lettering.
The connection point of the windshield wipers to the cowl appears slightly fused or indistinct, lacking clear mechanical definition.

artifact_observations.location: Front bumper and license plate area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The front bumper geometry is slightly irregular, and the license plate area lacks a clear recessed mount, appearing somewhat pasted on with soft edges.

To verify the structural integrity of the wheels and ensure they are properly grounded, and to check for any warping in the boxy body lines.
To rigorously analyze the illegible text artifacts observed on the front panel and windshield for coherence and generation errors.
To check for fusion artifacts where small protruding parts connect to the main body, ensuring clean boundaries.
To assess general photorealism and identify any subtle lighting or texture inconsistencies missed by specific audits.

Mechanical clarity of wipers and mirrors
Body line straightness and perspective consistency
